info.title: stanzasharp
info.description: The stanzasharp command: downloads Stanza's English models for StanzaSharp, checked against their MD5s, e.g. in a Dockerfile or CI. "stanzasharp download DIR [--package default_fast] [--processors tokenize,mwt,pos]". Needs no native libtorch.

options.name: --package
options.description: Stanza's English package: default, or default_fast (faster, no constituency)

options.name: --processors
options.description:
comma-separated, from tokenize,mwt,pos,lemma,constituency,depparse,sentiment,ner
(default: all of the package's)
